# OpenSciEd Course Metadata Documentation

## Overview

The OpenSciEd Course Metadata system generates comprehensive metadata for all available OpenSciEd courses and units. This documentation describes the structure, fields, and usage of the generated metadata files.

## Generated Files

### Primary Output

- **File:** `data/course_metadata_comprehensive.json`
- **Description:** Complete metadata for all courses and units
- **Generated by:** `scripts/generate_course_metadata.py`

### Viewing Script

- **File:** `scripts/view_metadata.py`
- **Description:** Human-readable metadata viewer with filtering options

## Metadata Structure

### Top-Level Structure

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "generated_at": "2024-01-XX",
    "version": "1.0",
    "total_units": 38,
    "processed_units": 2,
    "raw_units": 36,
    "courses": 8
  },
  "statistics": {
    "by_subject": {...},
    "by_grade_level": {...},
    "by_processing_status": {...}
  },
  "courses": [...],
  "units": [...]
}
```

### Metadata Fields

#### `metadata` Object

| Field             | Type    | Description                  |
| ----------------- | ------- | ---------------------------- |
| `generated_at`    | string  | ISO timestamp of generation  |
| `version`         | string  | Metadata schema version      |
| `total_units`     | integer | Total number of units found  |
| `processed_units` | integer | Units with processed content |
| `raw_units`       | integer | Units with only raw data     |
| `courses`         | integer | Number of identified courses |

#### `statistics` Object

| Field                  | Type   | Description                                        |
| ---------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `by_subject`           | object | Count of units by subject (Biology, Physics, etc.) |
| `by_grade_level`       | object | Count of units by grade level (K, 1, 2, etc.)      |
| `by_processing_status` | object | Count by processing status (processed, raw)        |

## Course Structure

### Course Object Fields

```json
{
  "course_id": "high_school_biology",
  "name": "High School Biology",
  "subject": "Biology",
  "grade_level": "High School",
  "description": "Complete OpenSciEd High School Biology curriculum",
  "units": ["B.1", "B.2", "B.3", "B.4", "B.5"],
  "total_units": 5,
  "processed_units": 2,
  "raw_units": 3,
  "course_output_exists": true,
  "course_output_path": "data/3_course_output/openscied_high_school_biology"
}
```

| Field                  | Type    | Description                               |
| ---------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `course_id`            | string  | Unique identifier for the course          |
| `name`                 | string  | Human-readable course name                |
| `subject`              | string  | Academic subject (Biology, Physics, etc.) |
| `grade_level`          | string  | Target grade level                        |
| `description`          | string  | Course description                        |
| `units`                | array   | List of unit IDs in this course           |
| `total_units`          | integer | Total number of units                     |
| `processed_units`      | integer | Number of processed units                 |
| `raw_units`            | integer | Number of raw units                       |
| `course_output_exists` | boolean | Whether course output exists              |
| `course_output_path`   | string  | Path to course output directory           |

## Unit Structure

### Unit Object Fields

```json
{
  "unit_id": "B.2",
  "course_id": "high_school_biology",
  "subject": "Biology",
  "grade_level": "High School",
  "processing_status": "processed",
  "data_paths": {
    "raw_data": "data/1_data_clean/B/B.2",
    "processed_content": "data/2_processed_content/B/B.2",
    "course_output": null
  },
  "metadata": {
    "title": "How do things inside our bodies work together to make us feel the way we do?",
    "overview": "Students investigate how the body's systems work together...",
    "ngss_standards": ["HS-LS1-2", "HS-LS1-3"],
    "estimated_lessons": 14,
    "last_processed": "2024-01-XX"
  },
  "files": {
    "overview": "overview.json",
    "ngss_standards": "ngss_standards.json",
    "lesson_materials": 14
  }
}
```

| Field               | Type   | Description                          |
| ------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `unit_id`           | string | Unit identifier (e.g., "B.2", "P.4") |
| `course_id`         | string | Associated course ID                 |
| `subject`           | string | Academic subject                     |
| `grade_level`       | string | Target grade level                   |
| `processing_status` | string | "processed" or "raw"                 |
| `data_paths`        | object | Paths to unit data                   |
| `metadata`          | object | Extracted unit metadata              |
| `files`             | object | Available files and counts           |

#### `data_paths` Object

| Field               | Type   | Description                                       |
| ------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `raw_data`          | string | Path to raw unit data                             |
| `processed_content` | string | Path to processed content (null if not processed) |
| `course_output`     | string | Path to course output (null if not generated)     |

#### `metadata` Object

| Field               | Type    | Description               |
| ------------------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `title`             | string  | Unit title/question       |
| `overview`          | string  | Unit overview description |
| `ngss_standards`    | array   | Associated NGSS standards |
| `estimated_lessons` | integer | Number of lessons in unit |
| `last_processed`    | string  | Last processing timestamp |

#### `files` Object

| Field              | Type    | Description                     |
| ------------------ | ------- | ------------------------------- |
| `overview`         | string  | Overview file name              |
| `ngss_standards`   | string  | NGSS standards file name        |
| `lesson_materials` | integer | Number of lesson material files |

## Unit ID Format

### Format Rules

- **Subject Prefix:** Letter indicating subject
  - `B` = Biology
  - `P` = Physics
  - `C` = Chemistry
  - `K` = Kindergarten
  - `1-8` = Grade levels 1-8
- **Unit Number:** Sequential number within subject/grade
- **Examples:** `B.2`, `P.4`, `6.1`, `K.1`

### Subject Mapping

| Prefix | Subject   | Grade Level       |
| ------ | --------- | ----------------- |
| `B`    | Biology   | High School       |
| `P`    | Physics   | High School       |
| `C`    | Chemistry | High School       |
| `K`    | Science   | Kindergarten      |
| `1-8`  | Science   | Elementary/Middle |

## Processing Status

### Status Types

- **`processed`**: Unit has been processed and has content in `data/2_processed_content/`
- **`raw`**: Unit exists in raw form in `data/1_data_clean/` but not yet processed

### Processing Indicators

- ✅ **Processed units** have:
  - Overview metadata
  - NGSS standards mapping
  - Lesson materials
  - Structured content files
- ⚠️ **Raw units** have:
  - Source materials only
  - No processed metadata
  - No standards mapping

## Usage Examples

### 1. Find All Biology Units

```python
import json

with open('data/course_metadata_comprehensive.json') as f:
    metadata = json.load(f)

biology_units = [unit for unit in metadata['units'] if unit['subject'] == 'Biology']
print(f"Found {len(biology_units)} biology units")
```

### 2. Get Processing Statistics

```python
stats = metadata['statistics']
print(f"Total units: {stats['by_processing_status']['processed'] + stats['by_processing_status']['raw']}")
print(f"Processed: {stats['by_processing_status']['processed']}")
print(f"Raw: {stats['by_processing_status']['raw']}")
```

### 3. Find Units by NGSS Standard

```python
target_standard = "HS-LS1-2"
matching_units = []

for unit in metadata['units']:
    if unit['processing_status'] == 'processed':
        standards = unit['metadata'].get('ngss_standards', [])
        if target_standard in standards:
            matching_units.append(unit['unit_id'])

print(f"Units covering {target_standard}: {matching_units}")
```

### 4. Generate Course Summary

```python
for course in metadata['courses']:
    print(f"Course: {course['name']}")
    print(f"  Units: {course['total_units']} total, {course['processed_units']} processed")
    print(f"  Status: {'✅ Complete' if course['course_output_exists'] else '⚠️ In Progress'}")
```

## Command Line Usage

### Generate Metadata

```bash
# Generate with default settings
python scripts/generate_course_metadata.py

# Specify custom output path
python scripts/generate_course_metadata.py --output custom_metadata.json

# Verbose output
python scripts/generate_course_metadata.py --verbose
```

### View Metadata

```bash
# View summary
python scripts/view_metadata.py data/course_metadata_comprehensive.json

# View all units
python scripts/view_metadata.py data/course_metadata_comprehensive.json --units

# View processing status
python scripts/view_metadata.py data/course_metadata_comprehensive.json --status

# View specific course
python scripts/view_metadata.py data/course_metadata_comprehensive.json --course high_school_biology
```

## Data Sources

### Raw Data Location

- **Path:** `data/1_data_clean/`
- **Structure:** `{subject}/{unit_id}/`
- **Content:** Source materials, teacher guides, student materials

### Processed Content Location

- **Path:** `data/2_processed_content/`
- **Structure:** `{subject}/{unit_id}/`
- **Content:** Extracted metadata, NGSS mappings, structured content

### Course Output Location

- **Path:** `data/3_course_output/`
- **Structure:** `{course_id}/`
- **Content:** Final course files, ready for publishing

## Schema Version History

### Version 1.0

- Initial metadata structure

## Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

1. **Missing Units**: Check if units exist in `data/1_data_clean/`
2. **Processing Status**: Verify processed content in `data/2_processed_content/`
3. **Course Output**: Check `data/3_course_output/` for generated courses

### Validation

The metadata generator includes validation for:

- File existence
- Directory structure
- JSON format integrity
- Required field presence

## API Integration

The metadata can be used to:

- Build course catalogs
- Generate progress reports
- Track processing status
- Map standards coverage
- Identify missing content

For programmatic access, load the JSON file and use the documented structure to access unit and course information.
